name: Courtyard by Marriott Bali Nusa Dua Resort
short_description: A select-service Courtyard resort in Nusa Dua's Tanjung Benoa area, near the Bali Collection shopping arcade and beach clubs.
ai_summary: Courtyard by Marriott Bali Nusa Dua Resort sits in the Tanjung Benoa area of the wider Nusa Dua enclave, within a short distance of the Bali Collection shopping arcade, local markets, and Nusa Dua's beach clubs. Rated 4 of 5 across roughly 2,500 TripAdvisor reviews and ranked in the top third of hotels in its immediate area, it's the select-service counterpart to the higher-tier Bonvoy resorts clustered in Nusa Dua, and guest feedback reflects that positioning well: rooms and grounds are repeatedly described as very clean and modern, the pool area (including a lazy river) draws consistent family praise, and staff are singled out as friendly and helpful with a genuinely positive atmosphere. Breakfast is another recurring highlight. The property isn't without friction -- one widely cited review describes a food-poisoning incident traced to an undercooked item, though the hotel's response with medical care and follow-up support was itself noted approvingly -- and as a select-service Courtyard, breakfast and other amenities aren't automatically bundled into every rate the way they might be at a full-service resort. For travelers who want Nusa Dua's gated resort setting and walkable proximity to shopping without paying full-service prices, it's a consistently well-reviewed option in this directory.

faqs.question: Is Courtyard by Marriott Bali Nusa Dua Resort close to the Bali Collection shopping area?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's located in the Tanjung Benoa part of the Nusa Dua enclave, a short distance from the Bali Collection shopping arcade, local markets, and Nusa Dua's beach clubs.

faqs.question: Does Courtyard by Marriott Bali Nusa Dua Resort include breakfast?
faqs.answer: Not on every rate -- as a select-service Courtyard property, breakfast is a frequently praised highlight for guests who purchase it, but it isn't automatically bundled into all room rates, so it's worth checking at booking.
